साउथ सिनेमा के फैंस के लिए आई है एक बेहद धमाकेदार खबर! 🔥
'रंगस्थलम' की ब्लॉकबस्टर सफलता के बाद राम चरण और डायरेक्टर सुकुमार फिर साथ आ रहे हैं। 🎬
फिल्म Peddi के बाद अब उनकी अगली फिल्म RC17 का आगाज 1 नवंबर 2026 को पूजा सेरेमनी के साथ होने जा रहा है। 💥
मेकर्स ने इस खबर पर मोहर लगा दी है और फैंस का उत्साह सातवें आसमान पर है! 🙌
क्या आप राम चरण और सुकुमार की इस जोड़ी का जादू दोबारा देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? कमेंट्स में बताइए! 👇

ctx.title: RC17: Post Peddi, Ram Charan’s next with Sukumar begins on November 1, 2026 after pooja ceremony
ctx.summary:
Ram Charan is all set to reunite with director Sukumar following the success of Rangasthalam. The tentatively titled RC17 is set to begin its journey with a pooja ceremony on November 1, 2026, as confirmed by the makers. 
 RC17: Ram Charan joins hands with Sukumar as pooja ceremony confirmed 
 Taking to their official social media handle, the makers of  RC17  announced the date and time of the film’s pooja ceremony. The project will officially commence with an auspicious ceremony on November 1, 2026, at 10:50 AM. 
 Here’s the post: 
 RC17 is an upcoming film produced by Mythri Movie Makers. Following their successful 2018 collaboration, the rural drama  Rangasthalam , the actor-director duo is coming together for what is touted to be a massive, big-budget project and is apparently aiming to release it in 2028. 
 Reportedly, Sukumar has spent over two years developing and fine-tuning the script. While the team has already begun pre-production work, the film is expected to go on floors in Hyderabad. 
 Although further details are yet to be officially announced, the film is reportedly an action-adventure entertainer set against an urban backdrop. There were also rumors that actresses Sara Arjun and Bhagyashrii Borse were being considered for the female lead. However, recent reports suggest that the makers are likely to cast a Telugu actress. 
 Meanwhile, Devi Sri Prasad was initially announced as the film's music composer. However, his name was absent from the latest announcemen
